items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Jimmy said to me, “Eiji, please introduce a young, good musician,”

ctx.x: Yes. I want to introduce good musicians. And do you know Jimmy Lyons? At the Monterey Jazz Festival. Jimmy said to me, “Eiji, please introduce a young, good musician,” And then I brought many musicians to the Monterey Jazz Festival. My pianist, Kotaro Tsukahara, he’s a very good pianist, and he’s a home player. I brought — how many musicians, I forgot.
That’s good. You’re helping other people get into jazz professionally.
